_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. install.ps1 creates config.json from this file on first run.

llm._upgradeDelaySec: others must stay vram.upgradeMarginMiB under a bigger tier's limit this long before it loads
llm._downgradeLoadDelaySec: outside games: after a downgrade unloads the bigger model, wait this long before loading the smaller one
llm._activityMaxTier: best tier allowed while a game/stream runs; applied the moment it starts, so the game launches with the memory free (games size texture pools at launch). "" = no cap
llm._activityPollSec: VRAM check interval while a game/stream runs (5 s otherwise)
llm._noLoadsDuringActivity: while a game/stream runs, only unload: model loads, upgrades and crash restarts wait until it ends (loading mid-game caused GPU driver resets)
llm._tiers: Best first. A tier is used while other programs (games, stream encoder, training jobs) use less GPU memory than maxOthersMiB. whisper=false also stops speech-to-text.
llm._tierOptions: Optional per tier: upgradeMarginMiB; upgradeDelaySec (idle seconds before upgrading INTO this tier); remoteStt / remoteDecision (allowed only while a worker's Whisper / Jev decisions are healthy, via router.py); model.estMiB (VRAM footprint to plan with); external (a server started by a scheduled task, e.g. Strata or Basalt: README > Big MoE tier). The example below goes first in tiers to use it.

strata._comment: README > Choose an engine, and docs/engines/. engine: strata (default: works out of the box on RTX 20-50), basalt (opt-in: upstream Basalt on RTX 50 or the basalt_ada fork on RTX 40; faster, 256K context) or hotrod (Strata-HotRod: Linux only, runs on another machine; no local task, use a gateway model with its url, docs/engines/hotrod.md). runConfig: the strata-<model>.json that `strata install --setup --no-start` wrote (environment variables are expanded); strataCmd: optional path of strata.cmd

basalt._comment: used when engine is basalt, for upstream Basalt (RTX 50) and basalt_ada (RTX 40) alike. root: the checkout or unpacked release; exe: optional, default bin\basalt.exe under root; args: optional extra serve arguments. config: start from basalt\basalt_blackwell.example.json (RTX 50) or basalt\basalt_home.example.json (RTX 40); its server.port must be the tier's LLM port (cluster.localPorts.llm on an orchestrator). cudaPath / venvScripts: leave empty when CUDA 13 is on PATH and a release archive's own .venv is used. anyModelName needs basalt\patches\0001-any-model-name.patch (the gateway sends the alias anyway)

tailscale._comment: Remote access over your tailnet (see README > Tailscale). Set enabled=false for LAN-only.

serve._comment: HTTPS ports published inside the tailnet only (0 = don't publish).

cluster._comment: Multi-PC (README > Multiple PCs). role: "" = single PC, "orchestrator" = keeps the public ports and routes to itself or workers, "worker" = loads models only while the orchestrator asks.
cluster._workers: mac (optional): the orchestrator wakes the worker with Wake-on-LAN while it needs it and the worker hasn't checked in for 20 s
cluster._preferWorkers: kinds ("stt", "tts") that always go to a healthy worker first, freeing this GPU for a bigger LLM tier (README > Bigger model with a worker doing speech); "tts" also needs localPorts.tts
cluster._decisionPort: orchestrator: a second public LLM port for Jev /v1/decision (e.g. 8082). Add "decision" to preferWorkers to answer decisions on a worker's model first (README > Jev decisions on a worker); point homellm_assist's decision URL at this port

gateway._comment: README > Model gateway. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint with an API key (keyFile, created by install.ps1) for every model and mode below; publish it with tailscale.serve.gateway.
gateway._keyDir: optional: one <label>.txt per machine, each holding one key (the label shows in gateway.log). Re-read on every request: delete a file to cut that machine off

hold._comment: models with whenDown hold: keep the request open (SSE comment lines / leading spaces as keepalive) until the model is back, then run it. Clients need a timeout above maxHours (README > Client templates)

gateway._decisionUrl: where Jev decisions go; empty = the router's decision port (cluster.decisionPort), else llm.port

rewarm._comment: after other callers' decisions, re-send Home Assistant's decision payload (scripts\ha_payload.py) so its prompt stays cached

models.name: Swift 1.5 125B (4090) - thinking from the client's effort selector
models._comment: no effort field: the client's reasoning_effort / chat_template_kwargs pass through (OpenCode variants, Hermes' selector); with none sent, the engine's default (reasoning_effort none) applies. While the tier is down (gaming): no tools and a short prompt -> fallback, anything else is held. ctx 262144 with Basalt

models.name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next on a Linux Strata-HotRod box (example; remove if unused)
models._comment: docs/engines/hotrod.md. A remote engine: no requireTier (the supervisor can't load or unload it for games). backendKeyFile holds the key HotRod was started with (--api-key) and is git-ignored. Give HotRod's config "aliases": ["home"] or set backendModel here
